excerpt: Oleksii Nabozhniak Senior lecturer, “Foundations of Economic Journalism / Economics for Journalists” Course CONTACT fb.com/oleksii.nabozhniak EDUCATION 2008: National University “Kyiv-Mohyla Academy”, Mohyla School of Journalism, Master’s degree in Journalism 2005: National University “Kyiv-Mohyla Academy”. Faculty of Humanities. Bachelor’s degree in Cultural Studies PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 2010 – present: Mohyla School of Journalism, NaUKMA. Senior lecturer in the course “Foundations of Economic Journalism / Economics for Journalists”. Also taught elective courses “Working with Expert Environment”, “Fact-Checking and Verification of Information”, “Working with Data and Information Registers” 2022 – 2023: Journalist and editor at the data journalism agency Texty.org.ua, author of data projects on the Russian influence on business and culture in Europe From 2023: Investigative journalist at the agency Slidstvo.Info – Ukrainian partner of the investigative network OCCRP 2011 – 2022: Worked in crisis communications and expert positioning (thought leadership), among key clients – government bodies, agro-sector enterprises, energy sector, banks, insurance companies, manufacturing enterprises, international investors, legal firms 2014-2018: Associated trainer of the project StopFake.org (training on fact-checking and verification of information, as well as on economic journalism for students, teachers, representatives of civil society, and regional editorial offices of Suspilne) within joint programs with international organizations 2001 – 2011: Worked in print and online media, television projects. Specialization – economics, regulatory policy, entrepreneurship, public finances and tax policy, infrastructure development, fuel and energy complex, agriculture
